purpose: U12: smoke test of ai-video on at least 3 GPU models
gpu_models_note: Minimum is 3 distinct models, each with >= min_vram_gb. List is a proposal; the owner decides the fleet.

fixture.how: python make_fixture.py image.png  (deterministic 256x256 gradient PNG); only for an image-to-video (MODEL_KIND=i2v) build. The default text-to-video build takes no input file.

prompts: a paper boat drifting on a calm pond, soft morning light

checks.expect: container exit code 0 and output.json ok=true
ffprobe: h264, yuv420p, 480x320, 9 frames, 8 fps, no audio stream
decoded frames differ from each other and pixel standard deviation of each frame > 8
re-run on the same GPU gives psnr_ssim verification status 'passed'
outputs of different GPU models pass the kit's psnr_ssim verification against each other (OWNER DECISION thresholds)
